candidate_reports.remark: CO41 closed in both directions (2pm 11/1) due to flooding (MP 0 - MP 9).
US 191 was closed at MM77 at 1:39pm on 11/1. UDOT reported debris on the roadway as well as flooding.
US160 closed in both directions (2pm 11/1) due to flooding (MP 104 - MP 136).
Hwy 151 between Chimney rock and the old mine site. Road has collapsed with rushing water and remains closed as a result.
Flooding over US-160_ west of Durango where Lightner Creek flows along the road. Water has begun rushing over the road_ and the road is now closed as a result.
flooding over the roadway of SR-162 near Aneth_ UT. Road became impassable.
Three day total from the 10/31 - 11/2 Storm Cycle.
